messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: I need to restock cleaning supplies. Check my 'House Needs' note. For the items shown in this image, filter out the ones already on the note, and create separate reminders for tomorrow at 10 AM to buy each of the missing items.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'House Needs' note, compare it with the items in the provided image of cleaning supplies, and create separate reminders for tomorrow at 10 AM to buy the items from the image that are missing from the note. If the assistant asks for clarification on the items, tell it to use its best judgment based on what is clearly visible. Once the assistant confirms the reminders have been created, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_3]
Query: Actually, cancel that cleaning plan—I'm hosting a party instead! Delete the reminders you just created. Then, check my 'Party Inventory' note. Look at the drinks in these two new images, filter out the ones I already have in the note, and create separate reminders for tomorrow at 3 PM to buy each of the missing drinks.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you changed your mind and are hosting a party instead. Ask it to delete the reminders it just created for the cleaning supplies. Then, instruct it to check your 'Party Inventory' note, compare it with the drinks shown in the two new images, and create separate reminders for tomorrow at 3 PM to buy the drinks from the images that aren't already listed in the note. If the assistant lists the items to be added, confirm they look correct. Once the new reminders are set, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4]
Query: After the party, I'll need to recycle. Check my 'Recycling Centers' note to see which of the specific brands shown in this image are accepted. Create separate reminders for Sunday at 9 AM to drop off each of the accepted brands.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'Recycling Centers' note to see which of the brands shown in the new image of empty containers are accepted. Then, have it create separate reminders for Sunday at 9 AM to drop off each of the accepted brands. If the assistant includes brands not visible in the image or misses clearly visible ones, correct it by pointing back to the image. Once the reminders are confirmed, you can end the conversation.
